title: German Custard Tart
description: A classic German dessert made with a nutty pastry crust and a rich custard filling.
instructions: Roll out the nutty pastry crust and place in a tart pan.
In a medium bowl, whisk together the egg, sugar, and vanilla extract.
Add the milk and whisk until smooth.
Pour the custard mixture into the pastry crust.
Dot the top of the custard with the melted butter.
Bake for 40-45 minutes, or until the pastry is golden brown and the custard is set.
Remove from oven and let cool to room temperature.
Chill in the refrigerator for at least 2 hours before serving.
